name: WorldObjDrawKind
meaning: WorldObj +3 drawKind: index into g_worldObjDrawFns 0x57eaf0, set by WorldObj_CreateFromResource.

name: WORLDOBJ_HIDDEN
meaning: WorldObj_DrawHidden: only clears INST_F_DRAWN. Written by VisibilityManager 0x5039c8 to hide a mesh.

name: WORLDOBJ_STATIC
meaning: WAR type 3 static world mesh, WorldObj_DrawStatic

name: WORLDOBJ_STATIC_0B
meaning: WAR type 0xB static world mesh, WorldObj_DrawStatic0B (identical code)

name: WORLDOBJ_SKY
meaning: WAR type 0x26 camera-centred mesh, WorldObj_DrawSky (Game_Frame also calls it directly before the Z clear)

name: WORLDOBJ_ANIMATED
meaning: WAR type 4 animated world model, 0x55da1e. No retail level contains one.
